scope: Replacement M01-light-matched separate soldier shadow atlases for accepted TargetMatchV5 facings and v5 animation frames.

source_generation.postprocess: workspace copy, chroma-key alpha extraction, split to four 256x256 facing frames, atlas packing, repeated per-frame animation shadow atlas, contact sheet, placement proof, metadata and validation

shadow_direction.map_light_match: cast trails lower-left / west-southwest from foot contact, matching v6 plate wall/building shadow direction
shadow_direction.z_order: below unit body, above v6 ground plate, below markers

placement_review.proof_assets: v6 plate + accepted v5 NW player body + accepted v5 SE enemy body + v5 markers + v7 shadows

binding_checklist.z_order: ground plate, v7 shadow, unit body, markers/health bars
binding_checklist.keep_units_from: TargetMatchV5 and soldier_animation_v5 accepted unit atlases

assessment.player_shadow: V7 trails lower-left from the accepted player foot contact and no longer reads as a compact oval or opposite-direction cast.
assessment.enemy_shadow: V7 uses the same map-light direction for enemy foot contacts and should sit with the v6 road/wall baked shadows without runtime offset guessing.
assessment.remaining: Needs PM/user visual approval and then Gameplay runtime proof binding.
